properties.title: AMNH Richard Gilder Center opened
properties.short_description: The American Museum of Natural History opened the Richard Gilder Center for Science, Education, and Innovation.
properties.explanation: A major museum expansion and new Columbus Avenue entrance entered public use.

properties.title: Barbara Kleiman Men's Shelter broke ground
properties.short_description: NYC Housing Preservation and Development announced groundbreaking for the Barbara Kleiman Men's Shelter, part of the Kingsland Commons redevelopment of the former Greenpoint Hospital campus, on April 26, 2023.
properties.explanation: A documented HPD announcement recorded the start of construction for a shelter phase within the Kingsland Commons redevelopment.

properties.title: Barkin, Levin & Company Office Pavilion was designated an individual landmark
properties.short_description: LPC designated the Barkin, Levin & Company Office Pavilion in Long Island City as one of two modern buildings landmarked that day.
properties.explanation: A mid-century commercial office pavilion in Queens received individual landmark protection.

properties.title: Barkin, Levin & Company Office Pavilion was designated an individual landmark
properties.short_description: NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission announced designation of the Barkin, Levin & Company Office Pavilion at 12-12 33rd Avenue in Long Island City as an individual landmark on December 19, 2023.
properties.explanation: A documented LPC vote changed the listed preservation status of the Barkin, Levin & Company Office Pavilion to individual landmark.

properties.title: Bronx Animal Care Center broke ground in Baychester
properties.short_description: NYC DDC recorded the 18 May 2023 groundbreaking for a new 50,000 square foot Animal Care Center in Baychester, Bronx.
properties.explanation: A documented construction phase began for a new public animal-care facility with admissions, adoptions, medical services, boarding, yards, exercise runs, courtyards, and community space.

properties.title: Bayside, Auburndale, and Flushing street-infrastructure project was completed
properties.short_description: NYC DDC, DEP, and DOT announced completion of a USD 79.7 million project that rebuilt streets and upgraded water, sewer, sidewalk, and catch-basin infrastructure in Bayside, Auburndale, and Flushing.
properties.explanation: The release documents 3.5 miles of rebuilt streets, new and replaced water mains and sewers, catch basins, hydrants, curbs, sidewalks, roadway, and micro-tunneled utility crossings under the Clearview Expressway.

properties.title: Gould Memorial Library renovation projects were marked complete at Bronx Community College
properties.short_description: Bronx Community College recorded a May 30, 2023 ribbon-cutting for completion of two capital projects at Gould Memorial Library, including dome and oculus reconstruction and an egress stair project.
properties.explanation: A documented completion or upgrade milestone was recorded for the named facility.

properties.title: Beach 108th Street reconstruction was completed
properties.short_description: NYC DDC, DEP, DOT, and MOCEJ announced completion of a USD 16.6 million project rebuilding Beach 108th Street in Rockaway.
properties.explanation: The release documents roadway reconstruction from Beach Channel Drive to Shore Front Parkway, safety upgrades, drainage work, and porous pavement on Beach 108th Street.

properties.title: Bedford Union Armory residential buildings opened
properties.short_description: NYC HPD recorded a March 21, 2023 celebration for New Yorkers moving into affordable homes at 1101 and 1089 President Street, the residential buildings in the former Bedford Union Armory redevelopment.
properties.explanation: Two new residential buildings on the Bedford Union Armory site were documented as open to residents with 415 total homes, including 250 affordable homes.

properties.title: Broadway Junction public-space investments were announced
properties.short_description: The NYC Mayor's Office announced on May 2, 2023 new public-space, jobs, affordable-housing, and street-safety investments around Broadway Junction.
properties.explanation: A documented city announcement recorded a public-realm and neighborhood-investment milestone around a major transit hub.

properties.title: Bronx Opera House was designated an individual landmark

properties.explanation: A documented LPC vote changed the listed preservation status of the Bronx Opera House to individual landmark.

properties.title: Bronx Point Phase 1 opened housing and public-space components
properties.short_description: NYC Housing Development Corporation recorded a ribbon cutting for Bronx Point Phase 1 housing and public-space components on 19 October 2023.
properties.explanation: A South Bronx waterfront mixed-use development phase entered use with affordable housing and public open-space components.

properties.title: Brooklyn Tower facade was complete as first residents moved in
properties.short_description: World-Architects reported on 5 September 2023 that Brooklyn Tower had recently seen its exterior facade completed and first residents were moving in.
properties.explanation: A supertall residential tower integrated with the former Dime Savings Bank reached visible completion and early occupancy in Downtown Brooklyn.

properties.title: Brower Park Library opened in the Brooklyn Children's Museum
properties.short_description: Tsao and McKown records Brower Park Library as a 2023 project, creating a new Brooklyn Public Library branch inside the Brooklyn Children's Museum.
properties.explanation: A new branch-library space entered documented use through adaptive reuse of museum space adjacent to Brower Park.

properties.title: Canarsie Pier Connector bike-lane link was completed
properties.short_description: NYC DDC and DOT announced completion of the Canarsie Pier Connector, a grade-separated two-way bike-lane link near Shore Parkway and Rockaway Parkway.
properties.explanation: The release documents a new section of raised bike lane, curb and sidewalk work, ADA pedestrian ramps, catch basins, hydrants, and tree planting linking Canarsie to the Jamaica Bay Greenway.

properties.title: Center for Brooklyn History reopened after renovation
properties.short_description: Brooklyn Public Library announced the grand re-opening of the Center for Brooklyn History after renovation, with free public access to the space, collections, and the Brooklyn Is exhibition.
properties.explanation: A renovated Brooklyn history archive and public exhibition space reopened to public access.

properties.title: City of Yes for Carbon Neutrality zoning text was adopted

properties.explanation: A documented citywide zoning text change was recorded for New York City's building and energy-infrastructure rule framework.

properties.title: (Former) Colored School No. 4 was landmarked and rehabilitation funding was announced

properties.short_description: Contemporary coverage recorded the former Domino Sugar Refinery reopening as an all-electric office building on 27 September 2023.

properties.title: Dongan Hills storm-sewer and street project was completed
properties.short_description: NYC DDC, DEP, and DOT announced completion of a USD 4.17 million project replacing water mains and sewers and rebuilding streets and sidewalks over nine blocks in Dongan Hills.

properties.title: East Flatbush Library reopened after renovation
properties.short_description: CityLand recorded East Flatbush Library reopening on 10 July 2023 after an 11.2 million USD renovation.
properties.explanation: A renovated Brooklyn branch library returned to documented public use with upgrades to technology, accessibility, community rooms, children's areas, and building systems.

properties.title: East Midtown Greenway opened
properties.short_description: NYCEDC and NYC Parks officially opened the East Midtown Greenway and Andrew Haswell Green Park Phase 2B on 19 December 2023.
properties.explanation: A new over-water pedestrian and cycling greenway segment entered public use along the East River.

properties.title: Engine Company 88/Ladder Company 38 Firehouse was designated an individual landmark
properties.short_description: NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission announced designation of Engine Company 88/Ladder Company 38 Firehouse as an individual landmark on June 13, 2023.

properties.title: Freshkills North Park Phase 1 opened to the public

properties.title: Gansevoort Peninsula opened in Hudson River Park

properties.explanation: A new public waterfront park and beach-like open space entered use on Manhattan's west side.

properties.title: Third Avenue Gowanus storm-sewer project was completed

properties.title: Grand Central Madison opened to LIRR service

properties.title: Grand Concourse Phase 4 reconstruction was completed

properties.explanation: The release documents rebuilt curbs, crosswalks, pedestrian ramps, lighting, medians, bicycle lanes, bollards, street repaving, sidewalks, catch basins, water mains, sewers, trees, and fire hydrants.

properties.title: High Line-Moynihan Connector opened

properties.explanation: A new elevated pedestrian connector linked the High Line, Manhattan West, and the Moynihan Train Hall area.
